contexts.text: The serpent can natural things.
Such things hurt... chaste ears.
If anyone injures, or tries to injure him... he hates him.
Therefore the Internal cannot be injured by man; for... he cannot injure what he does not know.
Lest they should be injured by the presence of the Divine Itself. Signified, Explained.
These griefs come forth from the injuring of the natural life.
Despair on account of the injuring of good. Signified.
It treats in () of those who injure or destroy the truth of faith or the good of charity with themselves or with others. AC 8971:end.
The injuring of the truth of faith... Signified, Explained.
They who, not on purpose, injure anyone as to the truths and goods of faith. Signified, Explained.
They who are from the Lord in the faith of truth and life of good cannot be injured by their poison...
The injuring of the good which is from truth. Signified, Explained.
If they have injured any thing in the interior Intellectual. Signified, Explained.
If they have injured or extinguished anything of the power of spiritual truth. Signified.
The injuring or extinction of the good of love. Signified.

It treats here, as in what precedes, of the injurings which take place in both the internal man and the external; for the injuring of the interior understanding is signified by the eye; and of the exterior by the tooth: and the injuring of the power of truth of the internal man, by the hand; and of the power of the external by the foot: thus, here, the injuring of the Voluntary of the internal man, by burning; and of the external by wound.
Wound is predicated of the injuring of good; and plague of the injuring of truth. Illustrated.
The extinction or injuring of the affection of truth. Signified, Explained.
If the internal man has injured the truth of faith in the external. Signified.
If the affection of evil in the Natural has injured the truth or good of faith. Signified.
Two truths... and the affection of one has injured the affection of the other. Signified, Explained.
There are falsities which do not injure; there are falsities which injure slightly, and others which injure grievously...
Beare of injuring the Word in any way; for they who injure it injure the Divine Itself.
That Divine truth... with (such) injures and lays waste. Signified, Explained. AC 9434:3.
Termination from good lest they be approached and injured by evils. Signified.
Also, lest those in Heaven be approached and injured by those in Hell.
When evil cannot injure good it is first indignant, then angry.
To have the Power of injuring men five mouths () = that they induce a kind of stupor on them... AR 439. AE 561.
Injure not the oil and the wine () = ... that the holy goods and truths... should not be violated and profaned.
Not to injure the grass of the earth... () = not to be able to take away any truth and good of faith.
That the inmost and more interior things of man cannot be injured; but only his interior things.
(Evil Spirits) live in such ignorance lest they should injure anyone.
I will not hurt the ears by reciting...
Not to injure = not to harm. AE 545.
In these they injure () = that thus they pervert the truths and goods of the Church.
Ulcers and wounds come forth from the injuring of the flesh and blood; and evils and falsities from the injuring of Divine good and Divine truth.
